source_review.judgment: Local correction-fence source gap closed; no required production repair remains.
source_review.scope: Independent architecture/source inspection of the three production files at the recorded hashes
source_review.final_concurrence: Full validated v2 cut is CAS-admitted before coarse worker lock; consumed ticket fences installed artifacts, promotion and final WMN response checks; pointer rollback cannot undo admission.

semantics.admission: A successful local durable admission transaction, not an upstream handoff-file replacement or native owner admission.
semantics.digest: SHA-256 of the complete validated, normalized WMN v2 payload encoded as UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no trailing newline.
semantics.artifact_digest_distinction: Publisher artifact bytes and Company canonical_json_bytes include a trailing newline; their byte hashes are intentionally different from the admission payload digest.
semantics.lock: Stable wmn_publication.lock inode, exclusive writer/shared read-only server flock; durable initialization marker prevents silent state-loss reset.
semantics.response_consistency_point: Final current-state recheck after JSONResponse encoding and before returning from the handler.
semantics.historical_reads: Legacy pointer/artifact versions remain historical-trial-readable; current WMN requires a matching fenced republish.

test_boundaries: New disk-backed API proofs use the actual publisher, installed bundle, composer and final eligibility gate with synthetic authentication and runtime-import seams.
The existing pure API harness stubs its publication recheck gate; it is not counted as native admission or final-gate proof.
The worker concurrency witness uses a real separate OS process for advisory-lock exclusion.
Source-context-only changes at the same Company event revision change the admission digest.
No actual entitled user session, upstream native owner artifacts, scientific validation, deployed API or source-rights admission is established by these fixtures.
remaining_gates: Native owner-authorized WMN v2 handoff with independently established Company event and DataOS issuer-master/vendor-alias custody and admission.
Adoption by the existing BioCatalyst native publisher and serving owner behind #6712, with both using the same durable admission state and pointer.
Compatible pointer 1.1.0 readers must precede writers that emit pointer 1.1.0.
Actual entitled list/detail serving and existing #9611 Decision Desk source-to-user proof.
Supported release-base adoption, exact-current-head hosted CI, serving packaging, and separate release approval.
limitations: Independent upstream file replacement alone does not invalidate a local ticket until the local acceptance transaction completes.
The final check cannot revoke an already in-flight HTTP response or an already displayed browser view.
Native runtime activation, deployment, production entitlement, source-rights qualification, scientific/trading approval and merge approval remain held.
Historical hosted failures at 43023495 are not current-head CI observations; local curated scope checks are not blanket hosted CI acceptance.
